placed.reason: Quality is rising, the business is cash-backed and the price is below its own 5-year minimum multiples, so the asymmetry justifies the 7% conviction-4 size. Two things keep conviction off 5: 4.74% dilution and a China VIE exposure that overlaps with HKG:9999. Communication Services goes to about 14% of the portfolio and cash stays far above the reserve, so no replacement is needed.

Cheap on every own-history and peer multiple, improving margins, self-funded buybacks and a non-cyclical, low-beta demand base give a favourable skew even on conservative EV/EBITDA-based targets. Disruption risk and INTU overlap keep conviction at 4, not 5: standard 7% core size. Cash, sector and holding limits are not breached.
